items.prompt: Instrumental space fleet battle music for a tactical strategy game, restrained and clear, brass and tactical percussion over a low string ostinato, steady 90 BPM, builds in intensity, no vocals, made to loop.

Instrumental tactical starship combat score, dark and focused, low brass, taiko and snare patterns, a pulsing synth bass under it, steady 100 BPM, no lead melody that tires the ear, no vocals, loopable.
Instrumental orchestral-electronic war music for a hex fleet tactics game, cold and calm tension, deep cellos, sparse brass stabs, military percussion, 85 BPM, no vocals, loopable.
Short instrumental victory and reward music for a space strategy game, warm brass and strings, quietly triumphant, not cheesy, no vocals.
Instrumental dark ambient synth drone for a star map screen, slow evolving pads, very calm, distant and vast, no beat, no vocals, loopable.
